subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: What final doctor diagnosis taxonomy and recovery-order output should OpenClaw standardize for mixed LaunchAgent, runtime, RPC, service-drift, and channel-conflict states?
rationale: Current main already collects many of the underlying facts, but the public verdict wording, probable-cause ordering, and optional JSON block are product/UX decisions that automation should not invent.

options.title: Compose a final doctor verdict
options.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps, rendered from existing service/runtime/RPC/channel facts.

options.title: Improve only individual panels
options.body: Leave doctor output as independent panels and tighten messages only when a live mixed-state transcript proves a specific confusing line.

options.title: Define structured diagnosis first
options.body: Add a machine-readable diagnosis object before changing prose, then render the final human panel from that object later.

recommendation.title: Compose a final doctor verdict
recommendation.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps, rendered from existing service/runtime/RPC/channel facts.
